title: Repair event pipeline regression across parser and sink
prompt: Fix the multi-file regression in the event pipeline. In `src/parser.rs`, parse_event correctly parses 'id|payload|checksum' lines, but has a field indexing bug when parsing the numeric checksum. In `src/sink.rs`, EventSink::push has an off-by-one capacity check that rejects valid events before reaching configured capacity. Fix both files so `cargo test` passes cleanly.
acceptance: All unit and integration tests in tests/test_pipeline.rs pass cleanly
